selection_rule: Use complete official reference-material certificates, official metrology guidance, complete union-authority recommendations and complete openly archived primary measurement records. Retain every row and condition on each registered surface, including favorable, adverse, absent, unavailable and unresolved outcomes.
development_exposure_disclosure: Before these seals, local historical support files and web identity/search surfaces exposed source titles, identifiers, measurement categories, some wavelength or wavenumber ranges, the existence of certificate coefficients and spreadsheet files, selected abstract-level numerical summaries, compound names, temperatures, qualitative presence or absence of phosphorescence and at least one Raman line inscription. The native laws and unique survivors were frozen before the web identity search. Every exposed item remains development-observed and is never relabelled blind. No complete registered coefficient, spectrum, quantum-yield, fluorescence-lifetime or phosphorescence-lifetime vector was captured or reconstructed before the seals.
